title: Selling Fonts Online Without PayPal: Which Architecture Actually Works for You
author: COREMERCH
excerpt: Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy block creators in dozens of countries. Here is the sovereign infrastructure that works everywhere they do not.

content.text: Many digital creators in Nigeria struggle to sell fonts online due to PayPal's restrictions. If you're among the hundreds of thousands of artists locked out by these global payment processors, you're not alone. Stripe, Gumroad, and Paddle also impose severe limitations or outright block users from certain countries. The result is an infrastructure gap where creators are forced to rely on manual, cumbersome, and insecure payment methods. This not only eats into their time and revenue but also exposes their customers to unnecessary risk. The answer lies not in finding a loophole or workaround but in building a sovereign commerce infrastructure that puts you in control. With the right architecture, you can bypass conventional payment processors and sell your fonts online without restrictions.
What Each Option Actually Offers

Conventional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal offer a range of features, including secure payment processing, subscription management, and fraud detection. However, they also impose significant fees, chargebacks, and compliance requirements that eat into your revenue. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is built on open-source tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase. These platforms provide a secure, scalable, and customizable foundation for your online store, allowing you to control every aspect of the transaction process. With a sovereign stack, you can manage your own payment processing, automate delivery, and maintain full ownership of your digital products.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Conventional payment processors often restrict access to certain countries or impose high transaction fees. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to operate globally, without geographic restrictions. By leveraging blockchain-based payment processing, you can accept payments in multiple cryptocurrencies and currencies, ensuring that your customers can buy from anywhere in the world. This not only increases your revenue potential but also helps you reach a wider audience without relying on patchwork workarounds.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Conventional payment processors charge high fees, often ranging from 2.9% to 5% per transaction, plus additional charges for things like cross-border transactions and chargebacks. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure typically charges lower fees, often under 1% per transaction, depending on the payment processor used. By cutting out the middleman and using a blockchain-based payment processor, you can save up to 90% on transaction fees. This means more revenue for you and less overhead to manage.
With a sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can sell your fonts online without relying on PayPal or other conventional payment processors.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Conventional payment processors often require you to store customer data and handle delivery, which can lead to security and compliance issues. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to automate delivery and handle all aspects of the transaction process, ensuring a seamless experience for your customers. By using a blockchain-based payment processor, you can also maintain full ownership of your digital products, without relying on third-party services or cloud storage.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice between conventional payment processors and sovereign commerce infrastructure ultimately depends on your specific needs and requirements. If you prioritize security, scalability, and customization, a sovereign stack may be the better choice. However, if you prefer a more straightforward, plug-and-play solution, a conventional payment processor may be more suitable. It's essential to weigh the pros and cons of each option carefully before making a decision.
